name: Swapping Onsen Ryokou~ Otonari Fuufu ni Ikasare Makuru Ore to Tsuma~
original_name: スワッピング温泉旅行 ～お隣夫婦にイカされまくる俺と妻～
source:
I have been married to my wife Kiyoka for 5 years. The relationship between us becomes cold and we no longer having sex with each other.

One day, our bitterness reaches its limit, and we finally have a fight. When we are about to come to a conclusion that a divorce is the only way to end our problem, the neighbor and his wife act as arbitrators and make a proposal.

"Swapping"

My wife will be held by another man, while I will be holding his wife.

By doing so, it is believed that we will have realized our spouse's charm and our love will be rekindled.

With this secret motive, my wife reluctantly agrees. Thus, we go on a hot spring trip with the neighbor and his wife.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1214787]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我与妻子清香结婚5年了。夫妻感情逐渐冷淡，也早已没有性生活。

某一天，双方的不满终于达到极限，大吵了一架。就在我们准备认定，只有离婚才能解决问题时，邻居夫妇出面调解，并提出一个建议。

“交换伴侣。”

妻子与另一个男人发生关系，而我则与他的妻子发生关系。

据说这样一来，我们便会重新发现伴侣的魅力，让爱情再次燃烧。

怀着这样的隐秘期待，妻子勉强答应了。于是，我们与邻居夫妇一起，踏上了温泉之旅。

[编译自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1214787]Getchu[/url]]
